title: User Registration with Valid Data
description: Verify that a new user can successfully register using valid information and receives a UUID-based user ID.

steps.description: Navigate to the user registration page.
Input valid registration details including email, password, and required personal info.
Submit the registration form.
Confirm registration success message is displayed.
Verify that the new user ID is a valid UUID and no timestamps are used.

title: Login with Correct Credentials
description: Ensure users and admins can login successfully with valid credentials and that session persists.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter valid username/email and password.
Submit the login form.
Verify that login is successful and session is established.
Reload the application and check session persistence.

title: Login Failure with Invalid Credentials
description: Verify that login fails gracefully with invalid username or password.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter an invalid username/email or incorrect password.
Attempt to submit the login form.
Confirm an error message is displayed indicating incorrect credentials.

title: Browse Product Categories and Filters
description: Verify users can browse product categories and apply search filters to narrow down product listings.

steps.description: Navigate to product categories page.
Select a product category.
Verify list of products under the selected category is displayed.
Apply multiple search filters (price range, brand, rating).
Confirm product list updates according to filters applied.

title: View Product Details
description: Ensure the product detail page displays all relevant information including images, descriptions, and rental options if applicable.

steps.description: From product listings, select a specific product.
Verify detailed product information is shown, including title, images, description, price, and rental availability.
Check that related products or recommendations are displayed.

title: Add and Remove Items from Shopping Cart
description: Verify adding multiple products and rentals to the shopping cart and ability to remove or update quantities.

steps.description: Select a product and add it to the shopping cart.
Add a rental item to the cart.
Confirm both items are visible in the cart with correct pricing and quantities.
Update quantity for one item.
Verify the updated quantity reflects correctly in the cart total.
Remove one item from the cart.
Check the item is removed and totals are recalculated.

title: Complete Checkout and Order Creation
description: Ensure the user can complete the checkout process and an order record is created and reflected in order management.

steps.description: Navigate to the shopping cart page with items added.
Proceed to checkout page.
Fill in required shipping and payment information.
Submit the order.
Confirm order success message and order ID.
Navigate to the orders page.
Verify the new order appears with correct details and status.

title: Create, Edit, and Delete User Advertisements
description: Test user flows for creating, modifying, and deleting product or rental advertisements.

steps.description: Navigate to 'My Ads' management page.
Create a new ad with valid product/rental details and media uploads.
Verify the new ad is listed and visible.
Select an existing ad and perform edit updates.
Confirm the changes are saved and displayed correctly.
Delete the ad.
Verify the ad is removed from the list.

title: Dynamic Content Loading and Fallback Mechanism
description: Verify banners, categories, and product content load dynamically from Supabase and fallback to static data if backend unavailable.

steps.description: Load the home page with Supabase backend services available.
Confirm dynamic banners, categories, and products display correctly from the backend.
Simulate backend service unavailability.
Reload the home page.
Verify content falls back to predefined static banners, categories, and products without errors.

title: Admin Panel CRUD Operations
description: Ensure admins can create, read, update, and delete products, users, orders, banners, and settings with UI updates reflecting changes.

steps.description: Admin logs into the admin dashboard.
Navigate to products management and create a new product.
Verify the new product appears in the product list.
Edit an existing product's details.
Confirm the product details update correctly.
Delete a product.
Ensure the product no longer appears in the list.
Repeat create, update, and delete tests for users, orders, banners, and settings.
Verify all changes reflect correctly in the UI and backend.

title: Real-Time Chat Message Sending and Receiving
description: Verify users can send and receive real-time chat messages instantly with proper storage and retrieval.

steps.description: User A opens a conversation with User B.
User A sends a text message.
Confirm User B receives the message instantly.
User B replies to User A.
Verify User A receives the reply instantly.
Check chat history is persisted and loads correctly on conversation reload.

title: User Profile and Settings Update
description: Ensure users can update their profile data, addresses, payment methods, and notification settings successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to user profile settings.
Update personal information fields.
Add a new address and update payment methods.
Modify notification preferences.
Save all changes.
Confirm all updates persist and reflect throughout the system.

title: Favorites Management and Persistence
description: Test that users can add and remove products to/from favorites and that the state persists across sessions.

steps.description: Navigate to a product detail page.
Add product to favorites.
Verify the product appears in the favorites list.
Remove the product from the favorites list.
Confirm the product is removed from favorites.
Logout and log back in.
Ensure favorites list state persists correctly.

title: Dark/Light Theme Switching
description: Verify that users can toggle between dark and light themes and that the preference is persisted and applied offline.

steps.description: Locate and activate theme toggle control.
Confirm the UI theme changes immediately.
Refresh the page and check if the selected theme persists.
Test theme switching while offline using PWA offline mode.
Verify theme preference still applies correctly.

title: PWA Installation and Offline Functionality
description: Test that the platform functions as a Progressive Web App with proper install prompting, offline access, and synchronization upon reconnect.

steps.description: Visit the platform on supported browsers and verify PWA install prompt is shown.
Install the app.
Confirm the app launches correctly as an installed PWA.
Simulate going offline.
Verify the app remains functional with cached content and allows navigation.
Reconnect to the internet.
Confirm data is synchronized and updates correctly.

title: File Upload for Media Management
description: Verify file uploads for product and ad images function correctly with progress indication, storage, and preview.

steps.description: Navigate to the ad creation or product edit page.
Select image files to upload.
Verify upload progress indicators appear.
Confirm images are successfully uploaded and previewed.
Submit the form.
Check uploaded media is saved and associated correctly.

title: Error Handling for Invalid UUID User IDs
description: Ensure system rejects and handles invalid UUIDs gracefully to prevent errors and consistency issues.

steps.description: Attempt to create a user/session with a timestamp or invalid UUID format.
Verify system rejects invalid UUIDs with an appropriate error and no database corruption.
Confirm error messages are user-friendly and consistent.

title: System Stability on Localhost Development Server
description: Confirm the system runs without runtime errors or debug logs on the local development server at http://localhost:8081/.

steps.description: Start the local development server on port 8081.
Open the application URL and navigate through all major flows.
Verify there are no runtime errors in console and no debug logs remain.

title: Geolocation Service Functionality
description: Test geolocation access requests and usage of location data for services correctly with fallbacks and permission handling.

steps.description: Access feature requiring geolocation.
Grant permission to access location.
Verify location-based services function and data is fetched accordingly.
Deny location permission and reload feature.
Confirm appropriate fallback mechanisms and messaging.
